_meta.description: Outcome archetypes for cooking. Each recipe in recipes.json references an outcome_id here. Many recipes -> one outcome (e.g. rat kidney and kobold kidney sauteed with mushroom both give small_recovery_perception). Buff types are canonical status_effects (see src/status_effects.py:BUFFS). temp_amount is buff-specific magnitude (interpreted by add_effect). temp_duration is turns. Trophies (T5) fire permanent_power via _apply_permanent_power in food_system.py.
_meta.buff_semantics: temp_power = status_effects.BUFFS name; temp_duration = turns; permanent_power = key into _apply_permanent_power dispatcher (preserved from v2.6.3).
_meta.tier_bands: T1: SP 30-50, HP 0-6, 30t buff, no perm bonus. T2: SP 50-75, HP 4-10, 60t buff. T3: SP 75-110, HP 8-15, 80t buff + occasional +1 max HP. T4: SP 100-135, HP 12-20, 100t strong buff + +2 max HP + occasional +1 stat. T5 non-trophy: SP 130-160, HP 18-25, 120t big buff + +3 max HP + +1 stat. T5 trophy: unique per-boss + permanent_power.

outcomes._comment_t1: TIER 1 — early-game (ml 1-15) — light snacks, quick refills, small buffs

t1_iron_rich.desc: Coppery iron on the tongue; you feel a little tougher.

t1_bone_broth.desc: A patient broth; the marrow steadies you.

t1_snack_perception.desc: Sharp on the palate; your eye finds its edge.

t1_snack_dark_vision.desc: The mushroom's chill spreads; the dark thins.

t1_snack_warning.desc: A jittery heat; you sense what lurks.

t1_snack_str.desc: Raw and bloody; a brief red mist rises.

t1_snack_regen_tick.desc: The moss carries a quiet knitting green.

t1_snack_shielded.desc: Coarse and gritty; your skin sets a little firmer.

t1_snack_blessed.desc: Faintly incensed; a small grace attends you.

t1_snack_sleep_resist.desc: Bitter herbs jolt the mind awake.

t1_snack_fear_immune.desc: A wild taste; nothing seems worth flinching from.

outcomes._comment_t2: TIER 2 — mid-early (ml 15-35) — proper dishes, meaningful buffs, family-tier meals

t2_hearty_meal.desc: A solid working meal; you feel restored.

t2_fat_and_marrow.desc: Fatty and dense; the marrow slides warm through you.

t2_broth_deep.desc: The broth is patient and deep; strength returns.

t2_organ_iron.desc: Rich with iron; you feel a heavy vigor.

t2_stew_max_hp.desc: The stew lingers; something new sets into you.

t2_meal_perception.desc: Sharp aromatics; the world sharpens with them.

t2_meal_dark_vision.desc: A slick, cool mouthful; shadow gives up its shape.

t2_meal_warning.desc: A prickling heat down the spine; you know when danger walks near.

t2_meal_see_invisible.desc: Eyes water and clear; the unseen has weight now.

t2_meal_poison_resist.desc: Sharp cured salt; the gut settles hard against foulness.

t2_meal_fire_resist.desc: Peppery heat coats the throat; fire slides off you.

t2_meal_cold_resist.desc: A warming stew; cold seems less able to reach you.

t2_meal_shock_resist.desc: A metallic snap in the aftertaste; the current has less purchase.

t2_meal_shielded.desc: A grounding, iron-savory meal; your guard sets.

t2_meal_magic_resist.desc: Ashen bitterness; something in you rejects the arcane.

t2_meal_berserk.desc: Half-cooked and bloody; a red heat behind the eyes.

t2_meal_regenerating.desc: A green, mossy edge; wounds close a little at a time.

t2_meal_hasted.desc: Bright and quickening; the world seems to slow a beat.

t2_meal_crit_buff.desc: The blade of the meal is precise; yours will be too.

t2_meal_blessed.desc: A quiet holiness; small graces attend.

t2_meal_dark_grace.desc: The dead cannot take from what has already fed.

t2_meal_save_dex.desc: Light on the tongue; you move a step ahead of harm.

t2_meal_save_wis.desc: A quieting draught; your will holds firm.

t2_meal_save_con.desc: A dense, iron-rich meal; the body braces.

t2_meal_identify_sight.desc: The palate teaches the eye; you understand what you see.

t2_meal_reflecting.desc: Bright and mirror-slick; light rebounds off you.

outcomes._comment_t3: TIER 3 — deep (ml 35-55) — real fortification, meaningful +max HP, strong buffs

t3_deep_marrow.desc: Deep marrow reaches you; the frame thickens.

t3_deep_stew.desc: Slow-simmered for hours; the depth sinks in.

t3_deep_organ.desc: Organ-rich and coppery; a heavy vigor settles.

t3_meal_perception.desc: The senses sharpen and stay sharp; the world quiets around you.

t3_meal_dark_vision.desc: The eyes take a slow drink; darkness gives up all its secrets for a long stretch.

t3_meal_see_invisible.desc: The unseen has weight and edge; nothing hides.

t3_meal_truesight.desc: For a while: no illusion, no glamour, only the thing itself.

t3_meal_telepathy.desc: The minds nearby press faintly on yours; the map fills in.

t3_meal_fire_resist.desc: Flame licks the tongue and turns friendly; the burning cannot reach far.

t3_meal_cold_resist.desc: A deep and lingering warmth; frost slides off with the grease.

t3_meal_shock_resist.desc: Copper and iron on the tongue; the current finds no path in.

t3_meal_poison_resist.desc: Fiercely salt-cured; the venoms of the deep have to work harder now.

t3_meal_fire_shield.desc: A crust of flame skins you for a while; attackers pay for reaching in.

t3_meal_cold_shield.desc: A rime of frost sets over you; the reaching hand freezes.

t3_meal_shielded.desc: Iron-hard fare; you set into a defensive stance without meaning to.

t3_meal_magic_resist.desc: A quenching, ashen depth; spells find you slippery.

t3_meal_regen.desc: The green, mossy note stays with you; wounds close on their own for a long while.

t3_meal_life_save.desc: The next mortal blow will not be mortal.

t3_meal_heroism.desc: A song rises in the throat; the world becomes something to answer.

t3_meal_hasted.desc: Quick and bright on the palate; the world moves a beat slower.

t3_meal_crit.desc: Every cut of the dish was precise; every cut of yours will be too.

t3_meal_riposte.desc: You feel the counter waiting in you; the next attack against you invites reply.

t3_meal_parry.desc: Balance settles; the parry rises without thought.

t3_meal_brilliance.desc: The mind clarifies; the spellwork sings.

t3_meal_control_immune.desc: The will steadies; nothing puppets you for a while.

t3_meal_drain_resist.desc: A dense, primal marrow; the dead reach past you and find nothing to take.

t3_meal_fear_immune.desc: You look at every fear and find it small.

t3_meal_stand_ac.desc: A grounding, root-heavy stew; when you plant, you HOLD.

t3_meal_save_all.desc: Balanced across every axis; the saves come true.

outcomes._comment_t4: TIER 4 — very deep (ml 55-80) — near-endgame; +2 max HP baseline, +1 stat on some, 100t strong buffs

t4_feast.desc: A serious feast; you rise from the table taller.

t4_feast_iron.desc: Iron and blood in every bite; the frame swells.

t4_feast_marrow_prime.desc: Prime marrow; deep bones become your bones.

t4_feast_str.desc: Raw strength runs through you; the muscle remembers.

t4_feast_con.desc: The body thickens and holds; hard things bounce off softer things.

t4_feast_dex.desc: Something quickens in the limbs; the reflexes learn a new speed.

t4_feast_int.desc: The mind opens like a wide bright hall; the spellwork sings.

t4_feast_wis.desc: A quieting; the will grounds and the world holds still around it.

t4_feast_per.desc: The senses dilate; the map fills in as far as the eye reaches.

t4_feast_fire_immune_temp.desc: A slow-lingering warmth; flame is a suggestion now.

t4_feast_cold_immune_temp.desc: The blood runs deep-warm; frost cannot find purchase.

t4_feast_all_saves.desc: Balanced and complete; every axis of the body holds.

t4_feast_life_save.desc: One more chance is baked in; the next killing blow will not be one.

t4_feast_heroism.desc: A great song rises in the throat; you answer everything.

t4_feast_displacement.desc: The eye slides off you; attacks find where you WERE.

t4_feast_spell_turning.desc: The arcane strikes turn back on their caster.

t4_feast_reflecting.desc: Light and force bounce back from you as if from mirror-glass.

t4_feast_regen.desc: The knitting-green stays and stays; a long, patient healing.

t4_feast_haste.desc: Time slows all around; the meal makes you swift.

t4_feast_control_immune.desc: The self is welded shut; nothing takes the wheel.

t4_feast_phasing.desc: The world becomes suggestion; you walk through walls a few times.

t4_feast_invisible.desc: The dish unmakes your outline; you fade from sight.

t4_feast_clairvoyant.desc: The mind's eye opens wide; you see the floor entire.

outcomes._comment_t5nt: TIER 5 non-trophy — apex meals (ml 80+, non-boss primes) — +3 max HP + +1 stat + strong buff

t5_apex_hearty.desc: An apex meal; the body remembers.

t5_apex_str.desc: The blood-note is deafening; the muscle takes what it wants.

t5_apex_con.desc: You set into the body like stone into earth; nothing shifts you.

t5_apex_dex.desc: You outpace the world; every reflex answers a beat early.

t5_apex_int.desc: The mind lifts wide and clear; the spellwork sings itself.

t5_apex_wis.desc: Balanced across body and mind; no attack finds a soft place.

t5_apex_per.desc: The world becomes only what it is; every glamour falls away.

t5_apex_life_save.desc: The body carries a spare thread of life; the killing blow finds it and stops.

t5_apex_regen.desc: A deep, patient knitting; wounds close as fast as they open.

t5_apex_all_elemental.desc: The great heat coats you and outlasts you; fire is a suggestion.

t5_apex_heroism.desc: A great song rises; you are the answer to every threat.

t5_apex_time_stopped.desc: For a handful of heartbeats the world stops; you do not.

outcomes._comment_t5trophy: TIER 5 TROPHY — one per boss (14 total). Each preserves the existing permanent_power dispatcher (_apply_permanent_power in food_system.py).

trophy_asterion.permanent_desc: The Minotaur's cunning is yours; you find the way and shake off confusion.
trophy_asterion.desc: Crown of the Labyrinth — the maze itself hums under your skin.

trophy_medusa.permanent_desc: Never again will stone claim you.
trophy_medusa.desc: Gorgon's Antitoxin — the mirror-drink; the gaze is now yours to answer, not to fear.

trophy_fafnir.permanent_desc: Each new floor you descend adds to your dragon-blooded frame.
trophy_fafnir.desc: Heart of the Dragon — a slow, terrible warmth spreads out from the middle.

trophy_fenrir.permanent_desc: The wolf's strength is now your strength.
trophy_fenrir.desc: Wolf-Bite Tonic — the ragged howl is answered in the marrow.

trophy_abaddon.desc: Apocalypse Pottage — every axis of the self rises together.

trophy_green_knight.permanent_desc: The holly-bough remembers you; death is not the end this run.
trophy_green_knight.desc: Honor-Bound Sash — the vow settles heavy and warm.

trophy_nidhoggr.permanent_desc: The world-serpent's mark; poison cannot touch you, and each descent widens the mind.
trophy_nidhoggr.desc: Root-Gnawer Brew — the earth's slow toxin becomes a hum you carry.

trophy_whispering_crone.permanent_desc: Secrets show themselves; the walls speak.
trophy_whispering_crone.desc: Wyrd-Whisper Tea — the old voice teaches you to listen wider.

trophy_blood_archon.permanent_desc: The blood-mage's strength is now yours.
trophy_blood_archon.desc: Sanguine Vitae — the rich red pours warm through you.

trophy_tiamat.permanent_desc: All five elements slide over you thereafter.
trophy_tiamat.desc: Five-Element Brew — every color of dragon runs cold-then-hot in the throat.

trophy_asmodeus.permanent_desc: The Pact is signed; the next death will not claim you.
trophy_asmodeus.desc: Infernal Compact — the ink dries in the blood.

trophy_surtur.permanent_desc: Fire will never harm you again.
trophy_surtur.desc: Lavabread — the ember at the middle stays hot for good.

trophy_ymir.permanent_desc: Cold will never harm you again.
trophy_ymir.desc: Primordial Stew — the great frost quiets inside you.

trophy_hrungnir.permanent_desc: Stone recognizes stone; nothing petrifies you again.
trophy_hrungnir.desc: Stone-Heart Loaf — the deep patience settles into the bones.
